changelog:
Initial release of debug-master, an enhanced debugging assistant.

- Introduces AI根因分析 (AI root cause analysis) and automatic test case generation.
- Expands错误模式库 (error pattern library) for smarter error recognition and solutions.
- Supports跨语言调试 (cross-language debugging) for 15+ popular programming languages.
- Provides context-aware修复建议 (smart fix suggestions) and代码质量扫描预警 (quality scanning & early warnings).
- Offers a comprehensive 7-step debugging methodology with detailed guides and templates.
summary: AI调试大师，集成7步调试法+根因分析+自动化测试+错误模式识别。触发词：'报错'、'出错了'、'debug'、'帮我看看'、'代码有问题'、'程序崩溃'、'修复bug'。相比原版debug-pro，新增AI根因分析、自动测试生成、错误模式库、跨语言调试。
